title: Concept: Dependency resolution does not target a fixed PHP version
description: composer.json declares a composer.json that declares no `config.platform.php`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a composer.json that declares no `config.platform.php`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a composer.json that declares no `config.platform.php`.
